title: PLI-GATE: positronium lifetime physics for GATE, with the analysis code of a prompt-selection study
description: A GATE 9.4.1 / Geant4 11.3 physics extension for positronium lifetime imaging that selects the ortho-positronium lifetime and yield by the material in which each positron comes to rest, from a provenance-tracked Tao-Eldrup and oxygen database, with the Ore-Powell three-photon channel. The release also contains the simulation macros, the analysis and figure scripts, the processed data and the registration files behind the paper "Material-dependent positronium lifetimes in GATE and prompt-selection bias" (D. Dhar and J. Peter, submitted to Physics in Medicine and Biology).
